title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-observability
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: This PR improves observability for the unified rollouts autorollback workflows. Motivation: teams running canary + A/B + shadow traffic needed clearer signals to trigger safe automatic rollbacks and to diagnose false positives. Summary of changes: 1) emit per-stage, per-variant aggregated metrics (latency_p50/p95, error_rate, model_quality_score) with consistent labels (rollout_id, stage, variant, region); 2) add a new rollback_decision_trace span that records the metric inputs, thresholds, and the decision path; 3) expose detailed sampling logs for shadow traffic discrepancies to a low-volume debug stream; 4) extend the autorollback engine to publish a human-readable decision reason and a compact fingerprint for later correlation with traces; 5) add e2e + unit tests and dashboard templates. Implementation notes: metrics use the existing observability client and adhere to cardinality limits by hashing variant IDs for high-cardinality values. Rollout decision trace is implemented as a lightweight span linked to request traces and persisted in the rollout audit log. Backward compatibility: all new metrics are additive and guarded by a feature flag (rollout_obs_v2) enabled by default for canary and shadow workflows. Checklist: - [x] add metrics + tracing - [x] update autorollback engine to include reason/fingerprint - [x] add tests (unit + e2e) - [x] add Grafana dashboard JSON and docs - [x] run perf microbenchmarks Results: CI green after flake fix, end-to-end test validates a simulated regression triggers decision path and publishes expected metrics. Related: references ENG-1423 for rollout telemetry schema and ENG-1471 for autorollback enhancements.

release_notes: Added enhanced observability for unified rollouts: per-stage metrics, rollback decision traces, and dashboard templates. Improves root-cause analysis for autorollback events.
notes: Feature flag rollout_obs_v2 enabled by default for canary and shadow rollouts; ops can toggle if cardinality or volume concerns appear. Deployed to staging 2024-11-10 and to prod after smoke tests 2024-11-12.
